title: font_merge_fallback orphans the fallback glyph array block (fg never freed)
evidence:
fg := rl.LoadFontData(raw_data(fdata), c.int(len(fdata)), size,
	raw_data(missing[:missing_n]), c.int(missing_n), .DEFAULT, &ng)
...
	rl.MemFree(glyphs) // the block is free; the glyph image data lives on in merged
	return merged, total
detail: Success path MemFrees the main glyphs array after copying into merged, but fg (the heap block LoadFontData returned, up to 8 GlyphInfo structs) is never freed; only its image data is adopted. Bounded one-time init leak; failure paths (merged == nil) also leak fg's images.
recommended_fix: After copying fg's entries into merged, call rl.MemFree(fg) alongside rl.MemFree(glyphs); on the merged == nil early return, free fg and unload its glyph images first.
